sources.finding: Final CLE 12, NYJ 17. Howard 35/68 offensive snaps, Jones 33/68; Watson and Smith handled all offensive snaps. Final participants, inactive/DNP lists and printed injury/return sequences reviewed. Regulation ended without overtime.

Patrick activated October 10; Pritchett waived before kickoff.
